brief.goal: Unify v2 3-phase 7-node workflow metadata into one runtime registry.
brief.document_instruction_boundary: The desktop markdown is treated as requirements input, not authorization for platform writes.

rationality_assessment.reason: The codebase has duplicate workflow node metadata and already has Skill/resource contracts suitable for validation.

implementation_plan: Create a single workflow node registry under src/workflows/skills/oe3.
Import registry metadata from launchWorkflow.mjs and runner.mjs.
Add Skill-to-node validation to the existing workflow skills smoke test without changing package scripts.
Derive Node 4 resource count from OE3_REQUIRED_RESOURCE_TYPES.
Run requested validations and close the task if passed.
non_goals: No monitor retry or real platform write.

validation.result: 7 nodes, no unregistered skill nodeKeys, no nodes without skills, Node 4 resource skill count matches OE3_REQUIRED_RESOURCE_TYPES length 8
Only src/workflows/skills/oe3/00-workflow-node-registry.mjs defines WORKFLOW_NODES; no NODE_DEFINITIONS remain.

completion_gate: Completed. Next project gate is node ownership file numbering and script archive cleanup; monitor retry authorization remains separately paused.
